## LoggingHelper.timeActive() method

Get all active timer labels.

**Signature:**

```typescript
timeActive(): string[];
```
**Returns:**

string\[\]

Array of active timer labels.

## Example


```typescript
const logger = new LoggingHelper();

logger.time("task1");
logger.time("task2");
const active = logger.timeActive();
// => ["task1", "task2"]
```
